items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: He was qualified and capable of playing it if he wanted to, but he was more interested in the popular thing.

ctx.x: Yeah, and they stayed in that dance field. I had thought that Piku did some classical music too. I think somebody told me. We haven't interviewed him very much so far. We did have one interview with him.
He was qualified and capable of playing it if he wanted to, but he was more interested in the popular thing. Because as you well remember, at that time, the Dixonite music was just a thing.
Yes, yes. Of course, that's our main study is going to be in that type of music. Yeah. We're glad to get all of the classical background because all of that helped.
